open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open exactly one transaction, read the replay candidate only through tx.progress_photos().get_progress_photo_by_intake_id with publication.intake_id, resolve a supplied section only through tx.project_sections().get_project_section with context.project_id inside that same transaction, insert only through tx.progress_photos().insert_progress_photo, append the audit only through tx.audit(), and commit exactly once; it MUST NOT call validate_project_section, open a second transaction while its own is active, or use a legacy transaction-level photo or project-section method.
open_points.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a photo already exists for publication.intake_id, MUST close that read transaction by exactly one rollback, marking it closed before the replay content comparison, then return the existing record with replayed true; a cross-project match or any content disagreement MUST raise PhotoConflictError. Neither replay path may insert a row, update a row, or append an audit.
open_points.question: Must the replay transaction commit exactly once, or must it roll back exactly once; alternatively, should the commit requirement be limited explicitly to the new-publication path?

open_points.subject: publish_progress_photo
open_points.text: - publish_progress_photo: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST apply intake_id replay, validate optional section project scope, persist one file_ref-backed photo, and append AuditAction.PHOTO_PUBLISH atomically; it MUST NOT set progress or financial values.
open_points.other_text: - publish_progress_photo: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a photo already exists for publication.intake_id, MUST close that read transaction by exactly one rollback, marking it closed before the replay content comparison, then return the existing record with replayed true; a cross-project match or any content disagreement MUST raise PhotoConflictError. Neither replay path may insert a row, update a row, or append an audit.
open_points.question: Must every call persist a photo and append PHOTO_PUBLISH, or must replay calls perform neither; alternatively, should persistence and auditing be limited explicitly to the new-publication path?

open_points.subject: update_progress_photo
open_points.text: - update_progress_photo: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST validate optional section project scope, change only caption/section/client_visible/updated_at, and append AuditAction.PHOTO_UPDATE atomically without changing file_ref, progress, or finance.
open_points.other_text: - update_progress_photo: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST carry the changed caption, section_id, client_visible, updated_at and updated_by by constructing a replacement ProgressPhoto from the one it read. It MUST NOT assign to any field of the photo returned by the repository or of any other model instance it received, because model instances are frozen and such an assignment fails at runtime.
open_points.question: Must updated_by be changed, or is the update restricted to only caption, section_id, client_visible, and updated_at?
